+"""Exercise the admitted preparation helper using only output-owned fixture data."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+helper, scratch, evidence = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])

+records = []
+cases = [
+    ('restores-executable-copy', None),
+    ('unsafe-input', 'duplicate/unsafe input'),
+    ('duplicate-input', 'duplicate/unsafe input'),
+    ('unsafe-inventory', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('duplicate-inventory', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('mode-out-of-range', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('mode-noninteger', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('inventory-pin-mismatch', 'inventory hash'),
+    ('source-hash-mismatch', 'snapshot mismatch'),
+    ('external-roots', 'external fixture roots'),
+    ('existing-work', 'output work already exists'),
+]
+for label, expected in cases:
+    base = scratch / 'fixture-controls' / label
+    source = base / 'snapshot'
+    output = base / 'output'
+    source.mkdir(parents=True)
+    output.mkdir()
+    original = b'#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n'
+    source_file = source / 'sample.sh'
+    source_file.write_bytes(original)
+    original_mode = source_file.stat().st_mode & 0o777
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()
+    row = dict(path='sample.sh', sha256=digest, mode=0o755)
+    entries = [row]
+    if label == 'unsafe-inventory':
+        row['path'] = '../escape.sh'
+    if label == 'duplicate-inventory':
+        entries.append(dict(row))
+    if label == 'mode-out-of-range':
+        row['mode'] = 512
+    if label == 'mode-noninteger':
+        row['mode'] = '0755'
+    inventory = source / inventory_path
+    inventory.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    inventory.write_text(json.dumps(dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=entries)))
+    allowed = [dict(path='sample.sh', sha256=digest),
+               dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory.read_bytes()).hexdigest())]
+    if label == 'unsafe-input':
+        allowed.append(dict(path='../escape.sh', sha256=digest))
+    if label == 'duplicate-input':
+        allowed.append(dict(allowed[0]))
+    if label == 'inventory-pin-mismatch':
+        allowed[1]['sha256'] = '0' * 64
+    if label == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+        source_file.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+    if label == 'existing-work':
+        (output / 'work').mkdir()
+    manifest = base / 'manifest.json'
+    manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+    source_arg = source
+    if label == 'external-roots':
+        source_arg = base / 'other-source'
+        source_arg.mkdir()
+    before = {str(p.relative_to(base)): (hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), p.stat().st_mode)
+              for p in base.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(helper), str(manifest), str(source_arg), str(output)]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    after = {p: (hashlib.sha256((base / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), (base / p).stat().st_mode)
+             for p in before}
+    assert before == after, label

+        assert copy.read_bytes() == original and copy.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o755

+    else:

+        assert not (output / 'work/sample.sh').exists()

+                        expected_rejection=expected, assertion='matched',
+                        stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr, fixture_inputs_unchanged=True))
+    print(f'{label}: exit={result.returncode}; expected outcome matched', flush=True)

+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os

+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BASE = OUT.parent
+SNAP = BASE / 'snapshot'

+PIN = '3587faa97e05ea6a361a115d57735bc940411abebc2c4dedfe1c3d3c88db978d'
+WORK = OUT / 'work'

+INVENTORY = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-4/source-modes.json'
+TMP = OUT / 'tmp'
+TMP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+for key in ('TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP'):
+    os.environ[key] = str(TMP)
+for key, suffix in [('XDG_CACHE_HOME', 'cache'), ('XDG_CONFIG_HOME', 'config'),
+                    ('XDG_DATA_HOME', 'data'), ('DOTNET_CLI_HOME', 'dotnet'),
+                    ('npm_config_cache', 'npm-cache')]:
+    os.environ[key] = str(TMP / suffix)
+os.environ['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
+os.environ['DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT'] = '1'
+
+def sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+def save(path, data):
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+def now():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+def run(label, args, cwd=WORK):
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', *args]
+    start = now()
+    begin = time.monotonic()
+    with (EV / (label + '.log')).open('wb') as log:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+                                stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)
+    record = dict(label=label, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), stdin='DEVNULL',
+                  started_at=start, ended_at=now(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-begin,
+                  exit_code=result.returncode,
+                  environment={k: os.environ[k] for k in ('TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP',
+                      'XDG_CACHE_HOME', 'XDG_CONFIG_HOME', 'XDG_DATA_HOME',
+                      'DOTNET_CLI_HOME', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE')})
+    save(EV / (label + '.json'), record)
+    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
+    return record
+
+assert sha(MANIFEST.read_bytes()) == PIN
+manifest = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_bytes())
+
+if sys.argv[1] == 'prepare':
+    before = []
+    seen = set()
+    for row in manifest['allowed_inputs']:
+        p = row['path']
+        assert not Path(p).is_absolute() and all(v not in ('', '.', '..') for v in p.split('/'))
+        assert p not in seen
+        seen.add(p)
+        file = SNAP / p
+        assert not file.is_symlink() and file.resolve() == file
+        assert sha(file.read_bytes()) == row['sha256'], p
+        before.append(dict(path=p, sha256=row['sha256'], mode=file.stat().st_mode & 0o777))
+    inventory = json.loads((SNAP / INVENTORY).read_bytes())
+    assert len(inventory['entries']) == 607
+    start = now()
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(SNAP / HELPER), str(MANIFEST), str(SNAP), str(OUT)]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=OUT, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True)
+    (TMP / 'prepare.stdout').write_bytes(result.stdout)
+    (TMP / 'prepare.stderr').write_bytes(result.stderr)
+    if result.returncode:

+        sys.exit(result.returncode)
+    EV.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    (EV / 'fixture-preparation.log').write_bytes(result.stdout + result.stderr)
+    save(EV / 'fixture-preparation.json', dict(command=command, cwd=str(OUT), stdin='DEVNULL',
+        started_at=start, ended_at=now(), exit_code=result.returncode, manifest_sha256=PIN,
+        admitted_inputs=len(before), inventory_entries=607, snapshot_before=before))
+    print(result.stdout.decode(), end='')
+elif sys.argv[1] == 'environment':
+    for label, args in [
+        ('version-os', ['sw_vers']), ('version-kernel', ['uname', '-smr']),
+        ('version-python', ['python3', '--version']), ('version-bash', ['bash', '--version']),

+        run(label, args)
+elif sys.argv[1] == 'suite':

+        'unified-launch-order': 'unified-launch-order.tests.py',
+        'review-conditional-inputs': 'review-conditional-inputs.tests.py',
+        'review-context-boundary': 'review-context-boundary.tests.sh',
+    }
+    label = sys.argv[2]
+    filename = 'tests/' + suites[label]
+    args = ['bash', filename] if filename.endswith('.sh') else ['python3', '-B', filename, '-v']
+    run(label, args)
+elif sys.argv[1] == 'negative':
+    run('fixture-negative-controls', ['python3', '-B',
+        str(EV / 'harness/fixture_controls.py'), str(SNAP / HELPER), str(TMP), str(EV)])
+elif sys.argv[1] == 'integrity':
+    before = json.loads((EV / 'fixture-preparation.json').read_text())['snapshot_before']
+    errors = []
+    for row in before:
+        file = SNAP / row['path']
+        if sha(file.read_bytes()) != row['sha256'] or file.stat().st_mode & 0o777 != row['mode']:
+            errors.append(row['path'])
+    inventory = json.loads((SNAP / INVENTORY).read_bytes())
+    copy_errors = []
+    for row in inventory['entries']:
+        file = WORK / row['path']
+        if sha(file.read_bytes()) != row['sha256'] or file.stat().st_mode & 0o777 != row['mode']:
+            copy_errors.append(row['path'])

+    assert not errors and not copy_errors and result['manifest_sha256'] == PIN

+"""Exercise the admitted preparation helper using only output-owned fixture data."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+helper, scratch, evidence = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
+inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-4/source-modes.json'
+records = []
+cases = [
+    ('restores-executable-copy', None),
+    ('unsafe-input', 'duplicate/unsafe input'),
+    ('duplicate-input', 'duplicate/unsafe input'),
+    ('unsafe-inventory', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('duplicate-inventory', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('mode-out-of-range', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('mode-noninteger', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('inventory-pin-mismatch', 'inventory hash'),
+    ('source-hash-mismatch', 'snapshot mismatch'),
+    ('external-roots', 'external fixture roots'),
+    ('existing-work', 'output work already exists'),
+]
+for label, expected in cases:
+    base = scratch / 'fixture-controls' / label
+    source = base / 'snapshot'
+    output = base / 'output'
+    source.mkdir(parents=True)
+    output.mkdir()
+    original = b'#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n'
+    source_file = source / 'sample.sh'
+    source_file.write_bytes(original)
+    original_mode = source_file.stat().st_mode & 0o777
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()
+    row = dict(path='sample.sh', sha256=digest, mode=0o755)
+    entries = [row]
+    if label == 'unsafe-inventory':
+        row['path'] = '../escape.sh'
+    if label == 'duplicate-inventory':
+        entries.append(dict(row))
+    if label == 'mode-out-of-range':
+        row['mode'] = 512
+    if label == 'mode-noninteger':
+        row['mode'] = '0755'
+    inventory = source / inventory_path
+    inventory.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    inventory.write_text(json.dumps(dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=entries)))
+    allowed = [dict(path='sample.sh', sha256=digest),
+               dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory.read_bytes()).hexdigest())]
+    if label == 'unsafe-input':
+        allowed.append(dict(path='../escape.sh', sha256=digest))
+    if label == 'duplicate-input':
+        allowed.append(dict(allowed[0]))
+    if label == 'inventory-pin-mismatch':
+        allowed[1]['sha256'] = '0' * 64
+    if label == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+        source_file.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+    if label == 'existing-work':
+        (output / 'work').mkdir()
+    manifest = base / 'manifest.json'
+    manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+    source_arg = source
+    if label == 'external-roots':
+        source_arg = base / 'other-source'
+        source_arg.mkdir()
+    before = {str(p.relative_to(base)): (hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), p.stat().st_mode)
+              for p in base.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(helper), str(manifest), str(source_arg), str(output)]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    after = {p: (hashlib.sha256((base / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), (base / p).stat().st_mode)
+             for p in before}
+    assert before == after, label
+    if expected is None:
+        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
+        copy = output / 'work/sample.sh'
+        assert copy.read_bytes() == original and copy.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o755
+        assert source_file.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == original_mode
+    else:
+        assert result.returncode != 0 and expected in result.stderr, result.stderr
+        assert not (output / 'work/sample.sh').exists()
+    records.append(dict(case=label, command=command, stdin='DEVNULL', exit_code=result.returncode,
+                        expected_rejection=expected, assertion='matched',
+                        stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr, fixture_inputs_unchanged=True))
+    print(f'{label}: exit={result.returncode}; expected outcome matched', flush=True)
+(evidence / 'fixture-control-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2) + '\n')
+print(f'{len(records)} controls matched; actual admitted inventory and snapshot were not modified')

+import datetime
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import time
+
+OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BASE = OUT.parent
+SNAP = BASE / 'snapshot'
+MANIFEST = BASE / 'manifest.json'
+PIN = '3587faa97e05ea6a361a115d57735bc940411abebc2c4dedfe1c3d3c88db978d'
+WORK = OUT / 'work'
+EV = WORK / 'specs/shared-review-launch-repair/verification/T-005/attempt-4'
+HELPER = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-4/prepare-fixture.cjs'

+TMP = OUT / 'tmp'
+TMP.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+for key in ('TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP'):
+    os.environ[key] = str(TMP)
+for key, suffix in [('XDG_CACHE_HOME', 'cache'), ('XDG_CONFIG_HOME', 'config'),
+                    ('XDG_DATA_HOME', 'data'), ('DOTNET_CLI_HOME', 'dotnet'),
+                    ('npm_config_cache', 'npm-cache')]:
+    os.environ[key] = str(TMP / suffix)
+os.environ['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
+os.environ['DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT'] = '1'
+
+def sha(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+def save(path, data):
+    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    path.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
+
+def now():
+    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+def run(label, args, cwd=WORK):
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', *args]
+    start = now()
+    begin = time.monotonic()
+    with (EV / (label + '.log')).open('wb') as log:
+        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
+                                stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, check=False)
+    record = dict(label=label, command=command, cwd=str(cwd), stdin='DEVNULL',
+                  started_at=start, ended_at=now(), elapsed_seconds=time.monotonic()-begin,
+                  exit_code=result.returncode,
+                  environment={k: os.environ[k] for k in ('TMPDIR', 'TMP', 'TEMP',
+                      'XDG_CACHE_HOME', 'XDG_CONFIG_HOME', 'XDG_DATA_HOME',
+                      'DOTNET_CLI_HOME', 'PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE')})
+    save(EV / (label + '.json'), record)
+    print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
+    return record
+
+assert sha(MANIFEST.read_bytes()) == PIN
+manifest = json.loads(MANIFEST.read_bytes())
+
+if sys.argv[1] == 'prepare':
+    before = []
+    seen = set()
+    for row in manifest['allowed_inputs']:
+        p = row['path']
+        assert not Path(p).is_absolute() and all(v not in ('', '.', '..') for v in p.split('/'))
+        assert p not in seen
+        seen.add(p)
+        file = SNAP / p
+        assert not file.is_symlink() and file.resolve() == file
+        assert sha(file.read_bytes()) == row['sha256'], p
+        before.append(dict(path=p, sha256=row['sha256'], mode=file.stat().st_mode & 0o777))
+    inventory = json.loads((SNAP / INVENTORY).read_bytes())
+    assert len(inventory['entries']) == 607
+    start = now()
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(SNAP / HELPER), str(MANIFEST), str(SNAP), str(OUT)]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=OUT, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, capture_output=True)
+    (TMP / 'prepare.stdout').write_bytes(result.stdout)
+    (TMP / 'prepare.stderr').write_bytes(result.stderr)
+    if result.returncode:
+        print(result.stdout.decode() + result.stderr.decode())
+        sys.exit(result.returncode)
+    EV.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    (EV / 'fixture-preparation.log').write_bytes(result.stdout + result.stderr)
+    save(EV / 'fixture-preparation.json', dict(command=command, cwd=str(OUT), stdin='DEVNULL',
+        started_at=start, ended_at=now(), exit_code=result.returncode, manifest_sha256=PIN,
+        admitted_inputs=len(before), inventory_entries=607, snapshot_before=before))
+    print(result.stdout.decode(), end='')
+elif sys.argv[1] == 'environment':
+    for label, args in [

+        ('version-node', ['node', '--version']), ('version-jq', ['jq', '--version']),
+        ('version-rtk', ['rtk', '--version']), ('version-claude', ['claude', '--version'])]:
+        run(label, args)
+elif sys.argv[1] == 'suite':
+    suites = {
+        'unified-task-launch': 'unified-task-launch.tests.py',
+        'task-structured-bindings': 'task-structured-output.tests.py',
+        'unified-quality-launch': 'quality-nontty-transport.tests.py',
+        'spec-review-verify-inputs': 'spec-review-verify-inputs.tests.py',
+        'host-launch-profile': 'host-review-preflight.tests.py',
+        'unified-launch-order': 'unified-launch-order.tests.py',
+        'review-conditional-inputs': 'review-conditional-inputs.tests.py',

+    }
+    label = sys.argv[2]
+    filename = 'tests/' + suites[label]
+    args = ['bash', filename] if filename.endswith('.sh') else ['python3', '-B', filename, '-v']
+    run(label, args)
+elif sys.argv[1] == 'negative':
+    run('fixture-negative-controls', ['python3', '-B',
+        str(EV / 'harness/fixture_controls.py'), str(SNAP / HELPER), str(TMP), str(EV)])
+elif sys.argv[1] == 'integrity':
+    before = json.loads((EV / 'fixture-preparation.json').read_text())['snapshot_before']
+    errors = []
+    for row in before:
+        file = SNAP / row['path']
+        if sha(file.read_bytes()) != row['sha256'] or file.stat().st_mode & 0o777 != row['mode']:
+            errors.append(row['path'])
+    inventory = json.loads((SNAP / INVENTORY).read_bytes())
+    copy_errors = []
+    for row in inventory['entries']:
+        file = WORK / row['path']
+        if sha(file.read_bytes()) != row['sha256'] or file.stat().st_mode & 0o777 != row['mode']:
+            copy_errors.append(row['path'])
+    result = dict(manifest_sha256=sha(MANIFEST.read_bytes()), snapshot_files=len(before),
+                  snapshot_hash_or_mode_changes=errors, work_files=len(inventory['entries']),
+                  work_hash_or_mode_changes=copy_errors, checked_at=now())
+    save(EV / 'integrity.json', result)
+    print(json.dumps(result))
+    assert not errors and not copy_errors and result['manifest_sha256'] == PIN

+"""Exercise the admitted preparation helper using only output-owned fixture data."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+helper, scratch, evidence = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
+inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-4/source-modes.json'
+records = []
+cases = [
+    ('restores-executable-copy', None),
+    ('unsafe-input', 'duplicate/unsafe input'),
+    ('duplicate-input', 'duplicate/unsafe input'),
+    ('unsafe-inventory', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('duplicate-inventory', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('mode-out-of-range', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('mode-noninteger', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('inventory-pin-mismatch', 'inventory hash'),
+    ('source-hash-mismatch', 'snapshot mismatch'),
+    ('external-roots', 'external fixture roots'),
+    ('existing-work', 'output work already exists'),
+]
+for label, expected in cases:
+    base = scratch / 'fixture-controls' / label
+    source = base / 'snapshot'
+    output = base / 'output'
+    source.mkdir(parents=True)
+    output.mkdir()
+    original = b'#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n'
+    source_file = source / 'sample.sh'
+    source_file.write_bytes(original)
+    original_mode = source_file.stat().st_mode & 0o777
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()
+    row = dict(path='sample.sh', sha256=digest, mode=0o755)
+    entries = [row]
+    if label == 'unsafe-inventory':
+        row['path'] = '../escape.sh'
+    if label == 'duplicate-inventory':
+        entries.append(dict(row))
+    if label == 'mode-out-of-range':
+        row['mode'] = 512
+    if label == 'mode-noninteger':
+        row['mode'] = '0755'
+    inventory = source / inventory_path
+    inventory.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    inventory.write_text(json.dumps(dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=entries)))
+    allowed = [dict(path='sample.sh', sha256=digest),
+               dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory.read_bytes()).hexdigest())]
+    if label == 'unsafe-input':
+        allowed.append(dict(path='../escape.sh', sha256=digest))
+    if label == 'duplicate-input':
+        allowed.append(dict(allowed[0]))
+    if label == 'inventory-pin-mismatch':
+        allowed[1]['sha256'] = '0' * 64
+    if label == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+        source_file.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+    if label == 'existing-work':
+        (output / 'work').mkdir()
+    manifest = base / 'manifest.json'
+    manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+    source_arg = source
+    if label == 'external-roots':
+        source_arg = base / 'other-source'
+        source_arg.mkdir()
+    before = {str(p.relative_to(base)): (hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), p.stat().st_mode)
+              for p in base.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(helper), str(manifest), str(source_arg), str(output)]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    after = {p: (hashlib.sha256((base / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), (base / p).stat().st_mode)
+             for p in before}
+    assert before == after, label
+    if expected is None:
+        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
+        copy = output / 'work/sample.sh'
+        assert copy.read_bytes() == original and copy.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o755
+        assert source_file.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == original_mode
+    else:
+        assert result.returncode != 0 and expected in result.stderr, result.stderr
+        assert not (output / 'work/sample.sh').exists()
+    records.append(dict(case=label, command=command, stdin='DEVNULL', exit_code=result.returncode,
+                        expected_rejection=expected, assertion='matched',
+                        stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr, fixture_inputs_unchanged=True))
+    print(f'{label}: exit={result.returncode}; expected outcome matched', flush=True)
+(evidence / 'fixture-control-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2) + '\n')
+print(f'{len(records)} controls matched; actual admitted inventory and snapshot were not modified')

+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+
+EV = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+WORK = EV.parents[4]
+OUT = WORK.parent
+BASE = OUT.parent
+manifest = json.loads((BASE / 'manifest.json').read_text())
+labels = ['unified-task-launch', 'task-structured-bindings', 'unified-quality-launch',
+          'spec-review-verify-inputs', 'host-launch-profile', 'unified-launch-order',
+          'review-conditional-inputs', 'review-context-boundary']
+results = []
+for label in labels:
+    record = json.loads((EV / (label + '.json')).read_text())
+    log = (EV / (label + '.log')).read_text()
+    record['unittest_counts'] = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'^Ran (\d+) tests?', log, re.M)]
+    record['check_summaries'] = [line for line in log.splitlines()
+                               if re.match(r'^(PASS:|FAIL:|SUMMARY|ok:|OK\b|Ran \d+)', line)]
+    record['skip_lines'] = [line for line in log.splitlines()
+                            if re.search(r'\bSKIP\b|\.\.\. skipped|^OK \(skipped=', line)]
+    record['log_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(log.encode()).hexdigest()
+    results.append(record)
+summary = dict(run_id=manifest['run_id'], task_attempt_count=4,
+               manifest_sha256=hashlib.sha256((BASE / 'manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+               spec_revision={r['path']: r['sha256'] for r in manifest['allowed_inputs']
+                              if r['path'].startswith('specs/shared-review-launch-repair/')},
+               suites=results, production_source_changes=[],
+               native_model_launch='NOT RUN', independent_review='NOT RUN',
+               formal_quality_gate='NOT RUN', current_head_ci='NOT RUN',
+               native_windows='NOT RUN')
+(EV / 'execution-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
+(EV / 'harness/revalidate.py').write_bytes((OUT / 'revalidate.py').read_bytes())
+print(json.dumps([dict(label=r['label'], exit_code=r['exit_code'],
+                       unittest_counts=r['unittest_counts'],
+                       check_summaries=r['check_summaries'], skip_lines=r['skip_lines']) for r in results], indent=2))

+"""Exercise the admitted preparation helper using only output-owned fixture data."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+helper, scratch, evidence = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
+inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-4/source-modes.json'
+records = []
+cases = [
+    ('restores-executable-copy', None),
+    ('unsafe-input', 'duplicate/unsafe input'),
+    ('duplicate-input', 'duplicate/unsafe input'),
+    ('unsafe-inventory', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('duplicate-inventory', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('mode-out-of-range', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('mode-noninteger', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('inventory-pin-mismatch', 'inventory hash'),
+    ('source-hash-mismatch', 'snapshot mismatch'),
+    ('external-roots', 'external fixture roots'),
+    ('existing-work', 'output work already exists'),
+]
+for label, expected in cases:
+    base = scratch / 'fixture-controls' / label
+    source = base / 'snapshot'
+    output = base / 'output'

+    output.mkdir()
+    original = b'#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n'
+    source_file = source / 'sample.sh'
+    source_file.write_bytes(original)
+    original_mode = source_file.stat().st_mode & 0o777
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()
+    row = dict(path='sample.sh', sha256=digest, mode=0o755)
+    entries = [row]
+    if label == 'unsafe-inventory':
+        row['path'] = '../escape.sh'
+    if label == 'duplicate-inventory':
+        entries.append(dict(row))
+    if label == 'mode-out-of-range':
+        row['mode'] = 512
+    if label == 'mode-noninteger':
+        row['mode'] = '0755'
+    inventory = source / inventory_path
+    inventory.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    inventory.write_text(json.dumps(dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=entries)))
+    allowed = [dict(path='sample.sh', sha256=digest),
+               dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory.read_bytes()).hexdigest())]
+    if label == 'unsafe-input':
+        allowed.append(dict(path='../escape.sh', sha256=digest))
+    if label == 'duplicate-input':
+        allowed.append(dict(allowed[0]))
+    if label == 'inventory-pin-mismatch':

+    if label == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+        source_file.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')

+        (output / 'work').mkdir()
+    manifest = base / 'manifest.json'
+    manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+    source_arg = source
+    if label == 'external-roots':
+        source_arg = base / 'other-source'
+        source_arg.mkdir()

+                        expected_rejection=expected, assertion='matched',

+    print(f'{label}: exit={result.returncode}; expected outcome matched', flush=True)

+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import re
+
+EV = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
+WORK = EV.parents[4]
+OUT = WORK.parent
+BASE = OUT.parent
+manifest = json.loads((BASE / 'manifest.json').read_text())
+labels = ['unified-task-launch', 'task-structured-bindings', 'unified-quality-launch',
+          'spec-review-verify-inputs', 'host-launch-profile', 'unified-launch-order',
+          'review-conditional-inputs', 'review-context-boundary']
+results = []
+for label in labels:
+    record = json.loads((EV / (label + '.json')).read_text())
+    log = (EV / (label + '.log')).read_text()
+    record['unittest_counts'] = [int(n) for n in re.findall(r'^Ran (\d+) tests?', log, re.M)]
+    record['check_summaries'] = [line for line in log.splitlines()
+                               if re.match(r'^(PASS:|FAIL:|SUMMARY|ok:|OK\b|Ran \d+)', line)]
+    record['skip_lines'] = [line for line in log.splitlines()
+                            if re.search(r'\bSKIP\b|\.\.\. skipped|^OK \(skipped=', line)]
+    record['log_sha256'] = hashlib.sha256(log.encode()).hexdigest()
+    results.append(record)
+summary = dict(run_id=manifest['run_id'], task_attempt_count=4,
+               manifest_sha256=hashlib.sha256((BASE / 'manifest.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
+               spec_revision={r['path']: r['sha256'] for r in manifest['allowed_inputs']
+                              if r['path'].startswith('specs/shared-review-launch-repair/')},
+               suites=results, production_source_changes=[],
+               native_model_launch='NOT RUN', independent_review='NOT RUN',
+               formal_quality_gate='NOT RUN', current_head_ci='NOT RUN',
+               native_windows='NOT RUN')
+(EV / 'execution-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + '\n')
+(EV / 'harness/revalidate.py').write_bytes((OUT / 'revalidate.py').read_bytes())
+print(json.dumps([dict(label=r['label'], exit_code=r['exit_code'],
+                       unittest_counts=r['unittest_counts'],
+                       check_summaries=r['check_summaries'], skip_lines=r['skip_lines']) for r in results], indent=2))

+"""Exercise the admitted preparation helper using only output-owned fixture data."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import subprocess
+import sys
+
+helper, scratch, evidence = map(Path, sys.argv[1:])
+inventory_path = 'handoffs/shared-review-launch-repair-T-005-attempt-4/source-modes.json'
+records = []
+cases = [
+    ('restores-executable-copy', None),
+    ('unsafe-input', 'duplicate/unsafe input'),
+    ('duplicate-input', 'duplicate/unsafe input'),
+    ('unsafe-inventory', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('duplicate-inventory', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('mode-out-of-range', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('mode-noninteger', 'inventory entry'),
+    ('inventory-pin-mismatch', 'inventory hash'),
+    ('source-hash-mismatch', 'snapshot mismatch'),
+    ('external-roots', 'external fixture roots'),
+    ('existing-work', 'output work already exists'),
+]
+for label, expected in cases:
+    base = scratch / 'fixture-controls' / label
+    source = base / 'snapshot'
+    output = base / 'output'
+    source.mkdir(parents=True)
+    output.mkdir()
+    original = b'#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n'
+    source_file = source / 'sample.sh'
+    source_file.write_bytes(original)
+    original_mode = source_file.stat().st_mode & 0o777
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest()
+    row = dict(path='sample.sh', sha256=digest, mode=0o755)
+    entries = [row]
+    if label == 'unsafe-inventory':
+        row['path'] = '../escape.sh'
+    if label == 'duplicate-inventory':
+        entries.append(dict(row))
+    if label == 'mode-out-of-range':
+        row['mode'] = 512
+    if label == 'mode-noninteger':
+        row['mode'] = '0755'
+    inventory = source / inventory_path
+    inventory.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
+    inventory.write_text(json.dumps(dict(schema='t005-fixture-modes/v1', entries=entries)))
+    allowed = [dict(path='sample.sh', sha256=digest),
+               dict(path=inventory_path, sha256=hashlib.sha256(inventory.read_bytes()).hexdigest())]
+    if label == 'unsafe-input':
+        allowed.append(dict(path='../escape.sh', sha256=digest))
+    if label == 'duplicate-input':
+        allowed.append(dict(allowed[0]))
+    if label == 'inventory-pin-mismatch':
+        allowed[1]['sha256'] = '0' * 64
+    if label == 'source-hash-mismatch':
+        source_file.write_bytes(b'changed fixture\n')
+    if label == 'existing-work':
+        (output / 'work').mkdir()
+    manifest = base / 'manifest.json'
+    manifest.write_text(json.dumps(dict(allowed_inputs=allowed)))
+    source_arg = source
+    if label == 'external-roots':
+        source_arg = base / 'other-source'
+        source_arg.mkdir()
+    before = {str(p.relative_to(base)): (hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), p.stat().st_mode)
+              for p in base.rglob('*') if p.is_file()}
+    command = ['rtk', 'proxy', 'node', str(helper), str(manifest), str(source_arg), str(output)]
+    result = subprocess.run(command, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, text=True, capture_output=True)
+    after = {p: (hashlib.sha256((base / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest(), (base / p).stat().st_mode)
+             for p in before}
+    assert before == after, label
+    if expected is None:
+        assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
+        copy = output / 'work/sample.sh'
+        assert copy.read_bytes() == original and copy.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == 0o755
+        assert source_file.stat().st_mode & 0o777 == original_mode
+    else:
+        assert result.returncode != 0 and expected in result.stderr, result.stderr
+        assert not (output / 'work/sample.sh').exists()
+    records.append(dict(case=label, command=command, stdin='DEVNULL', exit_code=result.returncode,
+                        expected_rejection=expected, assertion='matched',
+                        stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr, fixture_inputs_unchanged=True))
+    print(f'{label}: exit={result.returncode}; expected outcome matched', flush=True)
+(evidence / 'fixture-control-results.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2) + '\n')
+print(f'{len(records)} controls matched; actual admitted inventory and snapshot were not modified')
